name: ListJobsWithFilters

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the E-HPC cluster.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87116.html operation to query the cluster ID
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87116.html获取集群ID
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The page number to return.

Pages start from 1.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
当前页码。

起始值：1。

默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page. Maximum value: 50.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时设置的每页行数。最大值：50。

默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The users that run the job
parameters.help_zh: 执行作业的用户列表信息
parameters.name: users

parameters.help_en: The information about the queues in which the job is run
parameters.help_zh: 执行作业的队列列表信息
parameters.name: queues

parameters.help_en: The information about the computing nodes that are used to run the job
parameters.help_zh: 执行作业的计算节点列表信息
parameters.name: nodes

parameters.help_en: The name of the job. Fuzzy search is supported
parameters.help_zh: 作业名称。支持模糊查询
parameters.name: job_name

parameters.help_en:
The status of the job. Valid values:

all
finished
notfinish

Default value: all
parameters.help_zh:
作业状态。取值范围：

all：所有状态。

finished：已完成。

notfinish：未完成。

默认值：all
parameters.name: job_status

parameters.help_en:
The order in which jobs are sorted based on the execution time. Valid values:

asc: ascending order
desc: descending order
parameters.help_zh:
按照作业执行时间进行排序。取值范围：

asc：升序。

desc：降序
parameters.name: execute_order

parameters.help_en:
The order in which jobs are sorted based on the time when they are submitted. Valid values:

asc: ascending order
desc: descending order
parameters.help_zh:
按照作业提交时间进行排序。取值范围：

asc：升序。

desc：降序
parameters.name: submit_order

parameters.help_en:
The order in which jobs are sorted based on the time when they queue. Valid values:

asc: ascending order
desc: descending order
parameters.help_zh:
按照作业排队时间进行排序。取值范围：

asc：升序。

desc：降序
parameters.name: pend_order

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/188593.html operation to query the list of regions where E-HPC is supported
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/188593.html查询可以使用E-HPC的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The earliest time when a job is submitted. The value is a UNIX timestamp, which represents the number of seconds that have elapsed since the epoch time January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
parameters.help_zh: 作业最早提交时间。格式为Unix时间戳，表示从1970-01-01T00:00:00Z起所经过的秒数
parameters.name: create_time_start

parameters.help_en: The latest time when a job is submitted. The value is a UNIX timestamp, which represents the number of seconds that have elapsed since the epoch time January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
parameters.help_zh: 作业最晚提交时间。格式为Unix时间戳，表示从1970-01-01T00:00:00Z起所经过的秒数
parameters.name: create_time_end

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable asynchronous query
parameters.name: async
